cases.name: Jchandra Riana Brown
cases.about: Family said, "Jelly was one of a kind, she was always the life of the party with a beaming smile on her face. She brought joy & laughter wherever she went. Jchandra was a very enlivened young lady, who loved trying new things. She was involved in cheer, ceramics, volleyball, drama, photography..."
